يسل (form I)
# يَسُلُّ (yasullu) /ja.sul.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of سَلَّ (salla)
# يُسَلُّ (yusallu) /ju.sal.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
# يَسُلَّ (yasulla) /ja.sul.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla)
# يُسَلَّ (yusalla) /ju.sal.la/:
